request.text: An implant on WORKSTATION5 launched a tool that drove Excel on WORKSTATION6 over DCOM. Stop process 6172 (GruntHTTP.exe) on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: GruntHTTP.exe (PID 6172, a Covenant implant on pgustavo's Desktop) opened and started cmd.exe /c MoveExcel4.exe 172.18.39.6, and MoveExcel4 then connected to WORKSTATION6 on the DCOM port Excel listens on: the implant is moving laterally through Excel's DCOM interface. Stop PID 6172.
